import pytest
from jinja2 import Environment
from jinja2.nativetypes import NativeEnvironment

def test_macro_native_output(env):
    # Use NativeEnvironment to ensure native type handling
    native_env = NativeEnvironment()
    template = native_env.from_string(
        "{%- macro x() -%}{{- [5,6] -}}{%- endmacro -%}{{- x()[0] -}}"
    )
    # The bug causes this to return the string "[", but it should return the integer 5
    assert template.render() == 5

def test_macro_native_output_nested_list(env):
    native_env = NativeEnvironment()
    template = native_env.from_string(
        "{%- macro x() -%}{{- [[1,2],[3,4]] -}}{%- endmacro -%}{{- x()[0][1] -}}"
    )
    assert template.render() == 2

def test_macro_native_output_dict(env):
    native_env = NativeEnvironment()
    template = native_env.from_string(
        "{%- macro x() -%}{{- {'a': 1, 'b': 2} -}}{%- endmacro -%}{{- x()['b'] -}}"
    )
    assert template.render() == 2

def test_macro_native_output_string_in_list(env):
    native_env = NativeEnvironment()
    template = native_env.from_string(
        "{%- macro x() -%}{{- ['hello', 'world'] -}}{%- endmacro -%}{{- x()[0] -}}"
    )
    assert template.render() == "hello"
